summary: Iteration 23 — Anime Seasons layer fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest PASS covering season creation (auto slug s01/ova-1/movie-1/special-1, auto title Sezonul 1/OVA 1/Film 1/Special 1, unknown season_type falls back to 'season', duplicate slug 400, series-not-found 404, auto position from count), public list active-only, admin list-all incl. inactive + auth-required, GET by id/slug + pair endpoint (404 when season_slug doesn't belong to series_slug), PATCH (title/year update + slug collision 400), DELETE guard when has episodes (400) and success when empty, cascade delete of series (removes all seasons + detaches videos with anime_series_id=null, anime_season_id=null, is_anime=false), PATCH /api/videos derives anime_series_id from anime_season_id + returns 400 on invalid anime_season_id, GET /api/anime-series/{k} exposes both `seasons` and `episodes` (legacy compat) each with episode_count. Frontend: /anime/series/{slug} renders anime-series-seasons-grid with anime-season-card-s01 + anime-season-card-ova-1 (badge 'OVA' visible), clicking a season navigates to /anime/series/{s}/{seasonSlug} which renders anime-season-title + anime-season-back-link + anime-season-no-episodes (empty state). Bad pair /anime/series/{s}/does-not-exist renders anime-season-not-found. Admin → Serii Anime tab → anime-toggle-seasons-{sid} opens AnimeSeasonsManager (data-testid anime-seasons-{sid}) with the new-season form + new-season-btn-{sid} + 2 season-row-{id} listing (SEZON/OVA badges, episode counts, position inputs, active toggle, delete btn) — all present.

issues: A DialogOverlay from the site-wide Announcement modal blocks pointer events over the login form on first visit. Users must click the modal's Închide button before interacting. Not blocking (test worked around it) but real users hit the same overlay — consider disabling site announcements on /login /register, or lowering the overlay's z-index so critical forms remain interactive.

action_items: (Low priority) Suppress announcement DialogOverlay on /login and /register — currently intercepts pointer events before user closes it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5327 lines. Seasons router (lines 1080-1370, ~290 lines) is well-organised but pushes the monolith further past the 700-line threshold. Recommend extracting anime routes (series + seasons) into /app/backend/routers/anime.py in a follow-up.
list_seasons_of_series (line 1110) declares `admin: Optional[dict] = None` but never uses it — dead parameter. Not a bug, just misleading; remove or wire in real admin gating.

The `get_anime_season` (single-key) endpoint at /api/anime-seasons/{key} accepts a slug that could collide between series (e.g. two series each with a season slugged 's01'). It returns the first match, which is why the pair endpoint /anime-series/{s}/seasons/{sk} exists. Front-end (AnimeSeasonDetail.jsx) correctly uses the pair endpoint. Consider making single-key lookup id-only to eliminate ambiguity.

AnimeSeason has both `description` and `synopsis` fields, mirroring shorts_series. UI (AnimeSeasonsManager) only surfaces `description` — synopsis appears orphaned; either wire it into the manager or drop it from the model.
seed_data_creation: During pytest: created 3 TEST_S23_* series + associated seasons + 2 TEST_v_* video docs. All cleaned via cascade DELETE on series in fixtures / try-finally blocks. During Playwright: created 1 TEST_UI_S23_* series with 2 seasons (s01 + ova-1) and cascade-deleted at end. Final Mongo state: no lingering TEST_S23/TEST_UI_S23 documents.
